description: TAP role definitions — named, reusable capability bundles (the least-privilege set each protected built-in group/actor holds). The grant path is principal -> role -> capabilities; tap_auth/sync.py hard-syncs each protected group's Django permissions to its role here. A role lists explicit capabilities, or "*" (admin-only) meaning every defined capability, including ones plugins add later, so new caps auto-flow to admin without editing this file. Roles are security boundaries: edits are reviewed in git and guarded by tests (every named capability must be defined; the tap_bootloader role must exclude grid.purge/grid.delete). NOTE: the tap_cares.* roles live here in v0 for historical reasons; re-homing them so tap_cares ships its own roles is the per-app split (deferred). See spec-tap-auth-v0 req-tap-auth-roles.

tap_admin.description: Full administrative authority: every defined capability, explicitly via "*" so new plugin capabilities auto-flow to admin. Members are human initial admins (plus tap_test in test mode).

tap_bootloader.description: The bootloader program actor's least-privilege boot bundle: everything boot needs and no more. Deliberately EXCLUDES destructive grid demolition (grid.purge, grid.delete) so a boot bug cannot nuke the grid, and ai.delegate (boot does not delegate). See spec-tap-boot-v0 req-boot-phases.

tap_cares.collector.description: The single shared bundle for ALL collectors in v0 (per-collector actors are deferred to the plugin refactor). Collectors read existing nodes to resolve links, write/import their collected GRIFT batches, and run under the collector runtime.

tap_cares.scheduler.description: The scheduler program actor: writes its own operational bookkeeping (Schedule/ScheduleFire nodes + edges) and triggers collection runs. The triggered run itself executes as the collector actor, not the scheduler.
